title: Attention logit scale 0.088 -> 0.12
description: Added ATTN_SCALE = 0.12 to the hyperparameter block and passed it as softmax_scale to fa3.flash_attn_func, replacing FA3's default 1/sqrt(head_dim) = 0.0884 at head_dim 128 (x1.357 on attention logits); nothing else changed.
reflection: NEUTRAL/slightly negative: val_bpb 0.988490 vs the 0.988076 baseline, +0.00041 — inside the noise floor (sd 2.4e-4 to 7e-4 measured, larger by a1's reading). 1111 steps, 291.2M tokens, MFU 41.66%, 34.6GB, i.e. zero throughput cost as predicted. Final smoothed train loss 2.7617 vs the baseline's 2.7519, so if anything the model trained marginally worse — the direction is not a hidden win being masked by eval noise. Reading: the attention logit scale is FLAT here, and I think the mechanism is that this model already has two other regulators of logit magnitude — per-head QK RMS-norm (so q,k are unit-RMS regardless of scale) and the tanh logit softcap at 15 — so sharpening attention by 36% is absorbed rather than exploited. The transfer argument I made (modded-nanogpt sets attn_scale 0.12 at exactly head_dim 128 with exactly this QK-norm) was sound as a prior and simply does not pay in this configuration. Practical conclusion for the cell: attention-logit scale is a closed axis, do not spend another slot on 0.10/0.16. More generally this is the third zero-cost architectural knob (after U-net skips and HEAD_DIM) that turned out flat-or-worse, which strengthens the case that what is left to win is in the LR/schedule block and in throughput, not in the attention block.
